{{Top|leg}}
Deflectors provided limited protection against all types of energy. The '''deflector Mark III''' [[droid shield]]s were the most cost-effective of the heavy droid shielding systems and provided adequate protection from focused energy.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
